name: tell-tail
description: Tell-Tail local observability, with AI Activity for ChatGPT and Codex and a first-class Logs workspace.

interface.shortDescription: AI Activity for ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Open Tell-Tail AI Activity for supported desktop events, connections, MCP diagnostics and plugin results. Switch to Logs for desktop metrics or add your own application log files, with parsing, charts and recent errors. Persistent tool capture requires setup and a one-time Codex restart. AI capture is metadata only; added application logs include error previews. History stays bounded and in memory.
defaultPrompt: Set up Tell-Tail for ChatGPT and Codex.
Check Tell-Tail capture health and open Activity.
